notes.title: Big update!
notes.content:
Super tired so just gona list what I remember.  Might miss some stuff, its been a little while in the oven.
When in dev screenshot mode (f1) if you press (f2) it will take a steam screenshot, which will be embeded with your current location, and everyone in your current lobby.

You can now create a party in the main menu instead of having to go to your apartment in game.

Reworked AI so its more manageable to write stuff for it for fighting, and more generic so i can eventually apply it to everything.  And so they can fight each other instead of just the player.

I also changed to combat to affect AI (draws agro on damage) and faction related stuff to affect whos on sight.  Will probably need to keep tweaking though.

Now the zombie interaction after you steal the key to leave the starting area functions

The jeb moment in the cupboard works.

The procedural audio demo has been added and works.

And a path back to town after

A skip button on second playthrough so you dont have to re experience all of the intro stuff.

The main menu has a cool song i found on pixabay, and the logo kinda bops to it now, which was a fun distraction.

Probably more, i know i did misc fixes like bubble logic got muddled with ice logic.

But i need to sleep, its 4am.  So im going to push the build and go close my eyes.

Hope it feels a bit better.

Gona turn my focus to the town tomorrow.  Everywhere needs a lot of work, but it needs it the most atm.

If anyones interested in the procedural audio stuff, i did a twitter thread on the how i did it here.  https://twitter.com/JofersGames/status/1616174262410166284

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - Fluid persistance
notes.content:
Sorry i went dark for a bit, ive been wrestling with the fluid systems to try and give them a little more life.

Its still paint based like before but now i can do things like propagate flies around vomit patches
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/fe98fe5071f806524f716f181af636b71b4266e1.gif[/img]

And since that data is now in world space instead of uv space, i can do things like this so other npcs can smell your vomit and start hurling themselves,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/7b977f817bf9be7ba99d30ed8f4a203d499b27a2.gif[/img]

And by washing the vomit away with other fluids like the snow from the new snow gun

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/d8573a980ad854119bbd34b9b5e0ea76a89db302.gif[/img]

The flies slowly disperse.

The snow gun also triggers the new onhit freeze effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/3f895de6b34ea5a5d1087aae8cf1c09cde4e83d4.gif[/img]

But the most exciting part to me for the new systems is how oil extends the fire spread.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/95bda1f7b660ef9032c90c256ecc2033251d7340.gif[/img]

I Works with melee weapons too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/fa9fbbba9d22777451ce030b50c9edcb0bbff9b7.gif[/img]

And can be washed away in the same way the vomit is.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/d9fb70f9004731836278e0383aaae3a7e573bc72.gif[/img]

I also added a sword to test a concept of "shred" weapons that inflict "bleeding"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43118398/a1b7088f80016740be54998149fc630b47ae6dad.gif[/img]

Im kinda wiped after this patch, but the march forward must continue.

So its onto the real next fest grind now, its a mess atm.  It needs a LOT of work before that point, and im probably not going to make it with everything i want, so im going to have to really prioritise updates to certain places for the next few weeks and its not going to be fun.
